newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Teleconstructors sees sales up.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Teleconstructors sees sales up.

text.p: Specialty Teleconstructors Inc President Michael Budagher on Thursday said he expects fiscal 1997 revenues to exceed analysts' estimates as a result of recent acquisitions.
Budagher said he expects revenues for fiscal year 1997 ending June 30 to exceed analysts' median estimate of $34 million. Specialty reported revenues of $16.7 million for fiscal 1996.
"For fiscal 1997 I suspect our revenues may be somewhat over the analysts' expectations, simply because of the acquisitions we announced recently," Budagher said.
"That is of course contingent on these acquisitions closing before the June 30, 1997 year-end," he said in a telephone interview from the company's Cedar Crest, N.M. headquarters.
Budagher said the company was not far enough into the fourth quarter to comment on earnings estimates for that period or fiscal 1997.

He said the company continues to look at acquisitions to grow its business building and maintaining wireless communications transmitting and receiving facilities for providers of wireless communications services.
